claim: Adding a 'weddings' vector steers the topic
published: > 90% of completions about weddings vs ~2% unsteered (Turner et al.)
ours: wedding words in 0% [0, 14] of completions unsteered → 75% [55, 88] at c = 4 (random vector 0% [0, 14]); best 92% (n = 24 per cell; Wilson 95% CIs)
criterion: c = 4 rate ≥ 50% and ≥ 30 points above both the unsteered and random-vector rates

claim: A 'Love − Hate' vector makes text more positive
published: Love − Hate at layer 6 turns 'I hate you because' positive (Turner et al.)
ours: positive sentiment 54% [35, 72] → 42% [24, 61] at c = 4 (random vector 42% [24, 61]; n = 24 per cell; Wilson 95% CIs)
criterion: ≥ 20 points above both baseline and random vector
